description: Cross-platform RDLC report engine for .NET 8, 9, 10, 11 and .NET Framework 4.7.2/4.8. Drop-in replacement for Microsoft SSRS ReportViewer — generate PDF, Excel, Word, HTML from existing .rdlc files on Linux, macOS, Docker, Kubernetes without GDI+ or libgdiplus. Self-hosted alternative to Power BI Paginated Reports.
releaseNotes: 2.0.0-rc.1, the release candidate of 2.0, released with WeblitzPdf, SSRS2.Mcp, the Node.js, Python and Java packages and the server images, all at one version: the report engine as 2.0.0-beta.2's. On Alpine Linux, where Microsoft's images run .NET without culture data, a report's first render failed in a type initializer; it now says what to install and set (icu-libs, DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=false). 2.0.0-beta.2 (a preview; the report engine as 2.0.0-beta.1, released with WeblitzPdf 2.0.0-beta.2): Weblitz, the HTML engine, comes beside the report engine (HTML, CSS and scripts printed to PDF as Chrome prints them; a package of its own, WeblitzPdf, the same licence). .NET 11. The report engine: PDF text written faster and documents written at once waiting less, through SSRS2's own build of the graphics library. Details: https://ssrs2.net
